verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is the ecosystem that lets the Codex coding agent connect to (client-side) MCP-backed plugins like Slack, Notion, Figma, etc. Per the agent-role convention, this client-side MCP consumption doesn't make the 'serve an agent via official MCP server' axis applicable — there is no evidence Codex itself runs as an MCP server (e.g., an 'mcp serve' mode) for other agents to connect to.
